M3v8 adds an inactive staged embedding profile and source-attested, one-use Qdrant new-model staging. The active embedding profile and original physical collection are preserved.
Rebuild staging is a component, NOT the completed M3.5 new-model rebuild: activation and atomic profile-and-binding cutover remain blocked.
No live SillyTavern or Qdrant acceptance was available. Existing matrix ENABLED cells remain awaiting manual testing.
M3v10: Source-scoped model activation is ENABLED/AWAITING_MANUAL_TEST as a separate bounded capability. It is not an additional cell in the unchanged 70-cell legacy matrix.
M3v10: Existing 70-cell classifications remain 8 enabled, 57 blocked, 5 unsupported. No new capability is blocked solely for lack of user manual acceptance.

M3v10: Single-use activation chooses a new per-source embedding profile and journal-routed physical collection without changing global embedding defaults. Staging automatically reserves owned target identity; read-only preflight never mutates.
M3v10: Test coverage is fixture-backed, not live SillyTavern/Qdrant certification. User acceptance is outstanding.

M3v11: Qdrant repeated scoped empty and restore after a published, verified same-embedding collection generation are ENABLED/AWAITING_MANUAL_TEST. Fresh backup, exact generation-bound plan, full owned physical inventory, managed registry, ledger, immutable target receipt, source re-attestation and logical lock remain mandatory. Alias deletion is still blocked.

M3v12 enables one-shot guarded deletion of the currently ACTIVE collection after a verified Qdrant cutover. Historical physical collections are independently verified and RETAINED, not deleted. Missing historical backup/evidence blocks physical deletion.

Source-selected cross-model activation may begin at a never-provisioned canonical name. Only a terminal source-selection proof plus a fresh physical Qdrant 404 classifies that historical canonical as absent, not retained.

M3v12 permits more than 256 records by a source-attested checkpointed preembedding stage, processed in server-bounded 16-record calls. Preembedding resumes after process restart; final Qdrant collection creation/upsert is still one-shot and non-replayable after uncertainty.
M2 generic durable queue is not yet the physical rebuild coordinator; full end-to-end physical-stage resumption and general uncertain-operation adjudication remain blocked, not waived.
Qdrant real-host acceptance is the users manual test; implemented modes use ENABLED/AWAITING_MANUAL_TEST without claiming external certification.
